body:
Actual private failure-localization probes derived from public `6942715617829352c944b061018c7c71e37c468d` identify the first normalizer refusal in final HIR validation: `catalog_normalizer.tests.main`, `factored automaton nodes`, `ReplayBudget::reserve_array<Node> -> reserve_vec<Node> -> Automaton::node -> chain -> add_dag -> add_observations -> build_comparison`. Cap remains67108864; first request3072,remaining1992,floor0,mode6. Full logs, complete source/patches and limitations: [private diagnostic evidence](https://github.com/wavect/semaprax/tree/wavect/v0-10-0/docs/evidence/private-factored-node-discovery-20261015).

These probes add explicit PRIVATE unfunded stderr/backtrace observers only after a failed reservation and after child restoration. They are failure localization, not public support, whole-gap attribution, a total required budget, physical gain, cap recovery or agent-token evidence. The repeated numeric first refusal agrees across the instrumented probes. The earlier uninstrumented851 observation belongs to a different source and is not a matched performance arm.

Source target: `src/cleanup_plan/replay/factored.rs` Node/Automaton constructors. Every Node currently carries separate owning `moves: Vec<(Label, usize)>` and `epsilon: Vec<usize>`; chain creates a new node and one labelled movement per item, and generic vector growth acquires backing even for tiny edge lists. Investigate compact zero/single-edge storage with honest promotion, or another representation that reduces actual backing without duplicating nodes or changing path multiplicities. Do not assume this improves every shape: larger node headers, new controls and promotion may offset savings. Establish actual layouts and funding before choosing a design.

Acceptance in a later LARGE batch:
- Preserve a complete independently compiled old Node/Automaton constructor and complete old comparison receivers. No routing the old baseline through the new representation or padding its charges.
- Preserve node/edge order where contracted, exact weighted language/path multiplicities, all terminal types, duplicate/parallel/epsilon edges, DAG sharing, same-child and branching behavior, original still-executed work/overflow/error order and all six diagnostic fields. Test empty/single/many and exhaustive small old/current comparisons, malformed/later errors, growth/promotion refusals and full Drop.
- Pay every genuinely new initializer/receiving/borrow/Result/promotion/growth control and actual backing before acquisition, under the actual current owner. Keep old physical and semantic charges for work still executed; no refunds, credit from removed fees, cap/fuel changes, donor budgets or unpriced helper calls.
- Measure complete old/current charged reservation, actual allocation/reallocation and highwater through final Drop per fixture, including unfavorable cases. Retain old source assertions and authenticate full new source domains. No source-count or first-request-only performance claim.
- Re-run unchanged normalizer, retry and codec application owners; disclose actual failures. A representation win does not close808 or establish application fit without its positive gates.

This is distinct from831 singleton successor-target maps,838 weighted/closed maps,839 canonicalizer scratch,843 invocation receiving and833 nominal-layout scratch. No additional Cargo job per ticket: implement first, then integrate into the next focused batch.
title: (OPT) Reduce factored automaton node and tiny-edge backing with fully paid storage
